newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500s continue to rally late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500s continue to rally late.

text.p: April 22 - U.S. June S&P 500s continued to rally late in the day. The contract surged to 779.00, near resistance at 780.00 to 782.00. Traders said S&Ps gained momentum on talk of an imminent budget agreement and bond market's performance.
Clinton said he will discuss efforts with House and Senate Democrats to reach a balanced budget.
